description:
Add a release check to an organization, or replace the one with the same name. A check runs its checker on every publish. It informs by default: it records results and never refuses a release. effect "block" with block_at refuses a release that has a result at or above that severity, or that a checker could not check. list_checks shows the checkers and their settings.

Replacing a check replaces its settings: pass every non-secret setting again. A secret setting you leave out keeps its stored value when the checker is unchanged. Changing a check's checker or effect releases the deploys that waited only on it.

A secret passed in secrets travels through this conversation. That is the user's call to make: if they hand you the key, use it, and say that they could instead run `valet checks add`, which prompts for it without echoing, so it goes straight to Valet. The answer names the fields that were set and never their values. Requires connecting a Valet account.

block_at.description: The lowest severity that blocks. Required with effect block.

check.description: Required. The check's name: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, such as snyk-deps. An existing name is replaced.

checker.description: Required. The checker to run, spelled as list_checks reports it, such as builtin:secrets.

effect.description: inform (the default) records results and never refuses a release. block refuses one with a result at or above block_at.

org_name.description: The Valet organization that owns the check. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

secrets.description: The checker's secret settings, as field name to value. A value passed here travels through this conversation; leave it out and point the user at valet checks add when they would rather it did not. A field you leave out keeps its stored value.

settings.description: The checker's non-secret settings, as field name to value.

name: set_check
title: Add or replace a release check
